overview_description.description:
Gainspeed is redefining how cable networks are built. The company's Virtual CCAP solution enables cable operators to meet skyrocketing capacity requirements, respond to changing market demands, and rapidly deploy new services all while cost-effectively migrating their networks to a software-driven, all-IP architecture.

Gainspeed (formerly known as Cohere Networks) was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.

product.name: Entra vCMTS
product.description: A virtualized Cable Modem Termination System designed to provide scalability and throughput for DOCSIS 4.0 and Turbo DOCSIS 3.1, featuring an open, cloud-native design.

product.name: Network Access
product.description: Cable and fiber access networks designed to meet future bandwidth demands, including Entra Cable Nodes and Entra Fiber Nodes.

product.name: Content Distribution
product.description: Software solutions for protecting, transforming, and delivering video content.

product.name: Commercial Video
product.description: Solutions for delivering bulk video services to commercial properties.

product.name: Entra Distributed Access Platform
product.description: A platform supporting distributed access architectures, facilitating the delivery of video and data services over hybrid fiber coax and direct fiber connections.

product.name: Entra Access Controller (EAC)
product.description: A centralized, cloud-native tool for configuration and monitoring of cable access networks.
